name: Lithium (HTTP server / web framework)
baseline: actix-web (also ranked above h2o and other TechEmpower Framework Benchmarks entrants on the same composite score)
workload: TechEmpower Framework Benchmarks (TFB) composite-score suite: JSON serialization, plaintext, single/multi-row DB queries, Fortunes template rendering, and DB updates, using non-blocking HTTP I/O and pipelined/batched PostgreSQL queries.
claimed_speedup: Ranked #1 of all frameworks tested (composite score) in an August 2020 TFB continuous run. Author (HN user matt42): the non-batched build of Lithium is 'as fast, slightly faster on some tests, slightly slower on others' than H2O; notes actix-web's tokio-postgres client lacked the same query-batching optimization Lithium's libpq fork used. No single numeric multiplier stated.
compiler_and_flags: TFB Dockerfile for lithium builds on buildpack-deps:focal and installs clang; exact optimization flags live in the framework's compile.sh, which was not directly inspected this session, so flags are not fully confirmed.
tradeoffs: Async/pipelined Postgres query batching depends on a non-upstream patched fork of libpq (dating to a 2016 patch that was never merged upstream), a dependency risk the author himself flagged and which is shared with drogon; Linux/macOS only (no Windows support); framework is effectively superseded/merged from the author's earlier 'silicon' project.
caveats: A TechEmpower staff member (HN account posting as 'Brian from TechEmpower') publicly cautioned that the linked run was an unreviewed 'continuous' benchmark ('hasn't received the type of sanity checking we do for an official TFB round') and said the ranking 'should be taken with a grain of salt until the next official round is available.' This session could not load techempower.com's benchmark results UI (JavaScript-rendered) or tfb-status.techempower.com (host unreachable) to confirm an official-round ranking, exact requests/sec figures, or the CPU model used, so those remain unconfirmed. TechEmpower's FrameworkBenchmarks GitHub repo was archived (read-only) on 2026-03-24, so no further official rounds will supersede this result.
found_via: HN Algolia search 'lithium techempower' -> story https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=24315285 (posted by matt42, the project author); cross-checked against https://github.com/matt-42/lithium README claim 'ranked #1 on the TechEmpower benchmark (composite score)'.
